Branch `opencode/boxbox-surface`, single commit `79dc0db` ("compaction stops being invisible on the client: boxbox reads session.compacted"), 11 files, +584/-18. Worktree clean.

## files changed (with the anchors you'll want)

**1. `lib/fleet/types.ts`**
- `:60` `sessionCompacted: "session.compacted",` added to `EventTypes` (with the session family, after `sessionDiff`).
- `:233` `export type SessionCompactedProperties` — `sessionID: string` required, everything else optional: `trigger?: "auto" | "manual"`, `overflow?: boolean`, `tokensBefore?: number`, `durationMs?: number`, `summaryChars?: number`, `tailStartID?: string`. Header comment states the fleet rule (older serves emit `{sessionID}` alone).

**2. `lib/store/fleet.tsx`**
- `:849` `export type CompactionFact = { at; trigger?; overflow?; tokensBefore?; durationMs?; tailStartID? }` — transient, this tab's memory only.
- `:863` `export function compactionFact(props, at)` — the defensive wire fold: non-number/NaN/garbage-enum/empty-string values are dropped, not coerced. Pure, so it is what the decode tests drive.
- `:908` `assembleThread(..., compaction?: CompactionFact)` — new optional 8th param, defaults to nothing.
- `:1239-1259` the application: prefers `compaction.tokensBefore` for the seam's `before`; when the seam's `after` is still the estimate it re-derives it via `postCompactionEstimate(tokensBefore, summaryTokens)` so the two numbers on one seam agree. Binding: exact match on the compaction part's `tail_start_id` when the fact carries `tailStartID`, else the newest seam. No match = no change.
- `:1702` `private compactions = new Map<string, CompactionFact>()`, cleared in `purgeSession` (`:2631`), read in `assemble()` (`:2726`).
- `:2449-2485` the `EventTypes.sessionCompacted` case: records the fact, emits `fleet.compaction`, calls `recomputeUsage(k)` only when the session is hydrated (`messagesCache`/`titleCache` hit), then `reassembleThread(k)` (itself a no-op unless the thread is open).
- `:1698` `private outputLimits` filled alongside `contextLimits` in `loadProviders` (`:2243`), and `:3253` the session row gains `compactAtPct: compactAtPct(context, output)`.

**3. `components/bb/thread/parts.tsx`** (`PitSeam`)
- `:328` new `contextDelta(part)` returns `{ shown, spoken }`: `shown` is unchanged from today (`"142k → ~8k"` / `"→ ~8k"`), `spoken` is the a11y form (`"142k to about 8k"` — an arrow and a tilde are noise out loud).
- `:391` the disclosure button's accessible name is now `"open the pit stop summary, compacted 142k to about 8k"` (and `close …` when open). With no numbers it is byte-identical to the old name. Zero visual change when the data is absent.

**4. `lib/telemetry/schema.ts:377`** — one new kind `"fleet.compaction"`, doc + props `trigger` (TEXT, values auto/manual), `overflow` (INTEGER 0/1), `tokensBefore`, `durationMs`, `summaryChars` (all INTEGER, none required). Producer is the store's event handler. `lib/telemetry/db.test.ts:118` gains its row in `oneOfEach` so the per-kind view coverage test actually exercises it.

**5. `lib/fleet/usage.ts:52`** — `compactAtPct(contextLimit, outputLimit?)`: `reserved = min(20_000, output ?? 32_000)`, `round((context − reserved) / context × 100)`, `undefined` when there is no context limit, when the reserve eats the window, or when it rounds to ≥100 (a tick at the bar's end is a lie about precision). `components/bb/thread/thread-view.tsx:46-92` FuelGauge takes `compactAt?`, draws a 1px `bg-noir` cut positioned at `left: N%` inside a now-`relative` track, gated on `pct > 0`. Existing color thresholds and bar behavior untouched; aria-label and title gain `", compacts at N%"` / `" · compacts at N%"` only when the tick renders. Wired at `:544`.

**6. `GOTCHAS.md`** — one entry (worktree scar tissue): `bunx tsc --noEmit` in a never-built worktree reports three phantom `Cannot find name 'RouteContext'` errors from `app/api/hosts/**/route.ts` because tsconfig includes `.next/types/**/*.ts`; tier 0 is only trustworthy after one `bun run build`. Verified both ways this session.

## verification

- `bunx tsc --noEmit` — clean, exit 0 (after one `bun run build` generated `.next/types`; see the GOTCHAS entry).
- `bun run test` (`bun test lib`) — **621 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail**, 1525 expects. Bare `bun test` (adds `board/test`) — 716 pass, 6 skip, 0 fail.
- New tests: `lib/store/compaction.test.ts` (12 tests) — wire fixtures minimal `{sessionID}` and full enriched payload, both `satisfies SessionCompactedProperties`, decoded through `compactionFact`; a garbage-props test; seam tests for no-fact-equals-today, windowed thread gaining its before, serve count beating the derived one, the next real turn still owning `after`, `tailStartID` binding to its own seam among two, an unmatched tail id changing nothing, and a numberless fact touching nothing. `lib/fleet/usage.test.ts:146` — 6 `compactAtPct` cases (20k cap, small output limit, 32k fallback, no limit, reserve-swallows-window, rounds-to-100).
- `bun run build` — passes, "Compiled successfully in 6.3s", 27/27 static pages.
- **Screenshots: N/A.** Tier-2 visual verification against a real serve was explicitly out of scope and was NOT done. Nothing here has been driven against a live `cmx serve`; I have not seen the tick or the enriched seam render. No claim of "verified" beyond typecheck/unit/build.

## spec deviations (3, all small)

1. **Added `tailStartID` to the fact** (your list was `{at, trigger, overflow, tokensBefore, durationMs}`). Reason: without it the fact can only bind to "the newest seam", which mis-stamps an old seam for a beat when the event arrives before the new compaction request message reaches the cache. The tail id makes the binding exact; the last-seam rule remains the fallback for serves that enrich only some fields. If you want the fact minimal, drop `tailStartID` from `CompactionFact` (fleet.tsx:849), the `pitTails` map (`:956`) and the branch at `:1249` — the two tail-id tests in compaction.test.ts go with it.
2. **`durationMs` is a props column, not the envelope `ms`.** Followed your prop list verbatim, but note schema.ts's own envelope rule ("if a prop is worth filtering or grouping by across kinds, promote it to the envelope") and the `ms` doc ("duration in ms where the event has one") both point at `ms`. One-line change if you prefer the envelope; I did not emit both, duplication would be worse.
3. **Seam copy is unchanged; only the accessible name gained the words.** The visible seam already rendered `"compacted · everything above is folded into a summary"` with `"142k → ~8k"` right-aligned, so "show compacted before → after" was already satisfied visually — the enrichment is that the numbers now appear in cases where the window can't derive them, and that the a11y name carries them.

Two facts worth knowing for your server-side side: the client reads `tail_start_id` off the compaction PART for binding, so the event's `tailStartID` must be that same id to match; and `summaryChars` is telemetry-only on this side (nothing renders it). I deliberately did NOT add a GOTCHAS entry for the enriched wire shape — it isn't live-verified yet, and GOTCHAS is for paid-for knowledge. Worth adding once an enriched serve is deployed, along with re-pinning the full fixture in compaction.test.ts (its header says so).

Bohr's implementation came through with worktree isolation on the `opencode/boxbox-surface` branch, 621+ tests passing and a clean build, though tier-2 support isn't finished yet. The tailStartID binding is working well with exact matching, and it aligns perfectly with the server payload I'm sending — the compaction part's tail_start_id is there, and my publish logic correctly uses the selected.tail value.

The durationMs approach as a prop versus envelope milliseconds is fine as-is. Their branch isn't merged yet — I'm keeping the commits intact and will merge locally after cross-verification, but I won't push to main since that triggers a live deployment. The order matters: cmx fleet needs to deploy first, then boxbox can follow. the owner will handle the actual push when the server side is ready.

The typecheck passes, so I'm moving on to write the prefire tests. I need two test cases: one verifying that prefire caches a note and only anchors the delta on pass-2, and another checking that a stale prefire with a pruned head falls back to full history. For the second test, I'll need a helper to create an assistant with a completed tool part so I can apply a prune-stamp to it. I'm setting up a new describe block for session.compaction.prefire and writing both tests.

For test 1, I'm seeding eight message pairs with a wide provider (100k context, 32k output, prefire band at 72k-80k), pushing a reply containing a healthy summary plus a marker, then calling prefire with specific token counts. After that, I'll push another reply for pass-2, add a new user turn, and process everything through SessionCompaction with auto disabled. The assertions check that the result continues, the captured output contains the marker inside the previous-summary tag, and early head text like turn 0 is absent.

For test 2, I'm using the same setup but this time with prefire cached, then mutating an early assistant message by adding a tool part helper function that updates a message with a completed tool execution result.

I need to check the exact ToolPart schema shape from the existing test suite to match the structure correctly — specifically the tool, callID, and state fields with their nested time and metadata properties. Once I seed the assistant message with a tool part, I'll mark it as compacted to simulate a pruned state, then verify that pass-2 captures the full head text and the new summary prompt without the previous note.

For the test itself, I'm confirming that the tool part stays in HEAD at prefire time, the stamp covers the right slice range, and that mutations in pair 0 properly break the invariant. The prefire's filterCompactedEffect reads messages from the database through the runtime service, the user.findLast lookup works, and the LLM stub queue processes both the initial reply and the second reply with the capture — making sure the captured messages are stringified correctly like in the anchor test.

Now I'm working through the pass-2 delta: after prefire runs on 8 pairs, a new user turn gets added, and at process time the select function runs over the full history. With 9 user turns total and the tail keeping the last 2 turns within the 8k limit, the tail should be around turns 8-9 while the head covers pairs 0-6 or so. But prefire ran before that new turn was added, so its select over just 8 pairs would've put the tail at pairs 6-7, meaning cachedHead would've been pairs 0-5.

At process time with the new turn, the head becomes pairs 0-6 (14 messages), and I can find where the cached head ends by looking at the index of pair 5's assistant message — that's at index 11, so the delta is just pair 6 (2 messages). I'm verifying this worked by checking that the captured text includes "turn 6" but not "turn 0", which confirms the delta was correctly isolated.

There's a potential issue with token estimates varying and shifting the tail boundary, which could make pair 6 end up in the tail instead, leaving delta empty and breaking the assertion. But since the estimates are deterministic based on character count divided by 4, the boundaries should stay fixed for these fixed texts. I'll keep the assertions as-is and adjust if needed after the first run.

Now I need to look at Euler's recall test to find the exact completed-tool-part literal so I can avoid guessing at the schema, then write the tests.
Typecheck clean. Prefire tests need a completed tool-part fixture — euler's recall test already built exactly that shape, so borrowing its literal:

[from /root/boxbox_surface]: DONE — boxbox-side compaction surfacing implemented and committed in the worktree.

Branch `opencode/boxbox-surface`, single commit `79dc0db` ("compaction stops being invisible on the client: boxbox reads session.compacted"), 11 files, +584/-18. Worktree clean.

## files changed (with the anchors you'll want)

**1. `lib/fleet/types.ts`**
- `:60` `sessionCompacted: "session.compacted",` added to `EventTypes` (with the session family, after `sessionDiff`).
- `:233` `export type SessionCompactedProperties` — `sessionID: string` required, everything else optional: `trigger?: "auto" | "manual"`, `overflow?: boolean`, `tokensBefore?: number`, `durationMs?: number`, `summaryChars?: number`, `tailStartID?: string`. Header comment states the fleet rule (older serves emit `{sessionID}` alone).

**2. `lib/store/fleet.tsx`**
- `:849` `export type CompactionFact = { at; trigger?; overflow?; tokensBefore?; durationMs?; tailStartID? }` — transient, this tab's memory only.
- `:863` `export function compactionFact(props, at)` — the defensive wire fold: non-number/NaN/garbage-enum/empty-string values are dropped, not coerced. Pure, so it is what the decode tests drive.
- `:908` `assembleThread(..., compaction?: CompactionFact)` — new optional 8th param, defaults to nothing.
- `:1239-1259` the application: prefers `compaction.tokensBefore` for the seam's `before`; when the seam's `after` is still the estimate it re-derives it via `postCompactionEstimate(tokensBefore, summaryTokens)` so the two numbers on one seam agree. Binding: exact match on the compaction part's `tail_start_id` when the fact carries `tailStartID`, else the newest seam. No match = no change.
- `:1702` `private compactions = new Map<string, CompactionFact>()`, cleared in `purgeSession` (`:2631`), read in `assemble()` (`:2726`).
- `:2449-2485` the `EventTypes.sessionCompacted` case: records the fact, emits `fleet.compaction`, calls `recomputeUsage(k)` only when the session is hydrated (`messagesCache`/`titleCache` hit), then `reassembleThread(k)` (itself a no-op unless the thread is open).
- `:1698` `private outputLimits` filled alongside `contextLimits` in `loadProviders` (`:2243`), and `:3253` the session row gains `compactAtPct: compactAtPct(context, output)`.

**3. `components/bb/thread/parts.tsx`** (`PitSeam`)
- `:328` new `contextDelta(part)` returns `{ shown, spoken }`: `shown` is unchanged from today (`"142k → ~8k"` / `"→ ~8k"`), `spoken` is the a11y form (`"142k to about 8k"` — an arrow and a tilde are noise out loud).
- `:391` the disclosure button's accessible name is now `"open the pit stop summary, compacted 142k to about 8k"` (and `close …` when open). With no numbers it is byte-identical to the old name. Zero visual change when the data is absent.

**4. `lib/telemetry/schema.ts:377`** — one new kind `"fleet.compaction"`, doc + props `trigger` (TEXT, values auto/manual), `overflow` (INTEGER 0/1), `tokensBefore`, `durationMs`, `summaryChars` (all INTEGER, none required). Producer is the store's event handler. `lib/telemetry/db.test.ts:118` gains its row in `oneOfEach` so the per-kind view coverage test actually exercises it.

**5. `lib/fleet/usage.ts:52`** — `compactAtPct(contextLimit, outputLimit?)`: `reserved = min(20_000, output ?? 32_000)`, `round((context − reserved) / context × 100)`, `undefined` when there is no context limit, when the reserve eats the window, or when it rounds to ≥100 (a tick at the bar's end is a lie about precision). `components/bb/thread/thread-view.tsx:46-92` FuelGauge takes `compactAt?`, draws a 1px `bg-noir` cut positioned at `left: N%` inside a now-`relative` track, gated on `pct > 0`. Existing color thresholds and bar behavior untouched; aria-label and title gain `", compacts at N%"` / `" · compacts at N%"` only when the tick renders. Wired at `:544`.

**6. `GOTCHAS.md`** — one entry (worktree scar tissue): `bunx tsc --noEmit` in a never-built worktree reports three phantom `Cannot find name 'RouteContext'` errors from `app/api/hosts/**/route.ts` because tsconfig includes `.next/types/**/*.ts`; tier 0 is only trustworthy after one `bun run build`. Verified both ways this session.

## verification

- `bunx tsc --noEmit` — clean, exit 0 (after one `bun run build` generated `.next/types`; see the GOTCHAS entry).
- `bun run test` (`bun test lib`) — **621 pass, 5 skip, 0 fail**, 1525 expects. Bare `bun test` (adds `board/test`) — 716 pass, 6 skip, 0 fail.
- New tests: `lib/store/compaction.test.ts` (12 tests) — wire fixtures minimal `{sessionID}` and full enriched payload, both `satisfies SessionCompactedProperties`, decoded through `compactionFact`; a garbage-props test; seam tests for no-fact-equals-today, windowed thread gaining its before, serve count beating the derived one, the next real turn still owning `after`, `tailStartID` binding to its own seam among two, an unmatched tail id changing nothing, and a numberless fact touching nothing. `lib/fleet/usage.test.ts:146` — 6 `compactAtPct` cases (20k cap, small output limit, 32k fallback, no limit, reserve-swallows-window, rounds-to-100).
- `bun run build` — passes, "Compiled successfully in 6.3s", 27/27 static pages.
- **Screenshots: N/A.** Tier-2 visual verification against a real serve was explicitly out of scope and was NOT done. Nothing here has been driven against a live `cmx serve`; I have not seen the tick or the enriched seam render. No claim of "verified" beyond typecheck/unit/build.

## spec deviations (3, all small)

1. **Added `tailStartID` to the fact** (your list was `{at, trigger, overflow, tokensBefore, durationMs}`). Reason: without it the fact can only bind to "the newest seam", which mis-stamps an old seam for a beat when the event arrives before the new compaction request message reaches the cache. The tail id makes the binding exact; the last-seam rule remains the fallback for serves that enrich only some fields. If you want the fact minimal, drop `tailStartID` from `CompactionFact` (fleet.tsx:849), the `pitTails` map (`:956`) and the branch at `:1249` — the two tail-id tests in compaction.test.ts go with it.
2. **`durationMs` is a props column, not the envelope `ms`.** Followed your prop list verbatim, but note schema.ts's own envelope rule ("if a prop is worth filtering or grouping by across kinds, promote it to the envelope") and the `ms` doc ("duration in ms where the event has one") both point at `ms`. One-line change if you prefer the envelope; I did not emit both, duplication would be worse.
3. **Seam copy is unchanged; only the accessible name gained the words.** The visible seam already rendered `"compacted · everything above is folded into a summary"` with `"142k → ~8k"` right-aligned, so "show compacted before → after" was already satisfied visually — the enrichment is that the numbers now appear in cases where the window can't derive them, and that the a11y name carries them.

Two facts worth knowing for your server-side side: the client reads `tail_start_id` off the compaction PART for binding, so the event's `tailStartID` must be that same id to match; and `summaryChars` is telemetry-only on this side (nothing renders it). I deliberately did NOT add a GOTCHAS entry for the enriched wire shape — it isn't live-verified yet, and GOTCHAS is for paid-for knowledge. Worth adding once an enriched serve is deployed, along with re-pinning the full fixture in compaction.test.ts (its header says so).

Bohr's implementation came through with worktree isolation on the `opencode/boxbox-surface` branch, 621+ tests passing and a clean build, though tier-2 support isn't finished yet. The tailStartID binding is working well with exact matching, and it aligns perfectly with the server payload I'm sending — the compaction part's tail_start_id is there, and my publish logic correctly uses the selected.tail value.

The durationMs approach as a prop versus envelope milliseconds is fine as-is. Their branch isn't merged yet — I'm keeping the commits intact and will merge locally after cross-verification, but I won't push to main since that triggers a live deployment. The order matters: cmx fleet needs to deploy first, then boxbox can follow. the owner will handle the actual push when the server side is ready.

The typecheck passes, so I'm moving on to write the prefire tests. I need two test cases: one verifying that prefire caches a note and only anchors the delta on pass-2, and another checking that a stale prefire with a pruned head falls back to full history. For the second test, I'll need a helper to create an assistant with a completed tool part so I can apply a prune-stamp to it. I'm setting up a new describe block for session.compaction.prefire and writing both tests.

For test 1, I'm seeding eight message pairs with a wide provider (100k context, 32k output, prefire band at 72k-80k), pushing a reply containing a healthy summary plus a marker, then calling prefire with specific token counts. After that, I'll push another reply for pass-2, add a new user turn, and process everything through SessionCompaction with auto disabled. The assertions check that the result continues, the captured output contains the marker inside the previous-summary tag, and early head text like turn 0 is absent.

For test 2, I'm using the same setup but this time with prefire cached, then mutating an early assistant message by adding a tool part helper function that updates a message with a completed tool execution result.

I need to check the exact ToolPart schema shape from the existing test suite to match the structure correctly — specifically the tool, callID, and state fields with their nested time and metadata properties. Once I seed the assistant message with a tool part, I'll mark it as compacted to simulate a pruned state, then verify that pass-2 captures the full head text and the new summary prompt without the previous note.

For the test itself, I'm confirming that the tool part stays in HEAD at prefire time, the stamp covers the right slice range, and that mutations in pair 0 properly break the invariant. The prefire's filterCompactedEffect reads messages from the database through the runtime service, the user.findLast lookup works, and the LLM stub queue processes both the initial reply and the second reply with the capture — making sure the captured messages are stringified correctly like in the anchor test.

Now I'm working through the pass-2 delta: after prefire runs on 8 pairs, a new user turn gets added, and at process time the select function runs over the full history. With 9 user turns total and the tail keeping the last 2 turns within the 8k limit, the tail should be around turns 8-9 while the head covers pairs 0-6 or so. But prefire ran before that new turn was added, so its select over just 8 pairs would've put the tail at pairs 6-7, meaning cachedHead would've been pairs 0-5.

At process time with the new turn, the head becomes pairs 0-6 (14 messages), and I can find where the cached head ends by looking at the index of pair 5's assistant message — that's at index 11, so the delta is just pair 6 (2 messages). I'm verifying this worked by checking that the captured text includes "turn 6" but not "turn 0", which confirms the delta was correctly isolated.

There's a potential issue with token estimates varying and shifting the tail boundary, which could make pair 6 end up in the tail instead, leaving delta empty and breaking the assertion. But since the estimates are deterministic based on character count divided by 4, the boundaries should stay fixed for these fixed texts. I'll keep the assertions as-is and adjust if needed after the first run.

Now I need to look at Euler's recall test to find the exact completed-tool-part literal so I can avoid guessing at the schema, then write the tests.
Typecheck clean. Prefire tests need a completed tool-part fixture — euler's recall test already built exactly that shape, so borrowing its literal:
